core: Negative regulation of plasma membrane cation transport
name: Negative regulation of plasma membrane Ca2+, Na+ and K+ transport
rationale: Members restrain calcium, potassium and sodium flux across the plasma membrane; the sodium-transport members set it apart from confusables centred on action potentials, K2P channels or cardiac repolarisation.

name: Sema3A and Sema4D plexin repulsive signaling
rationale: All members are semaphorin-plexin signalling events (including RND1 binding plexins) causing growth-cone collapse and loss of adhesion, whereas confusables are general axon guidance, ephrin, netrin or G12/13-Rho signalling.

name: Transcriptional and cellular response to UV irradiation
rationale: Members are UV-induced and UV-repressed gene programmes plus cellular response to UV-B, distinct from the confusable nucleotide-excision repair of UV damage and from TNF/NF-kB stress programmes.

core: AMPA receptor trafficking and postsynaptic localization
name: Endosomal AMPA receptor trafficking and postsynaptic clustering
rationale: Members concern delivery, clustering, trapping and internalisation of AMPA-type glutamate receptors at the postsynapse and their effect on excitatory transmission and short-term plasticity, unlike confusables centred on NMDA/kainate receptor activation and LTP.

name: Endocannabinoid synthesis, degradation and retrograde synaptic signaling
rationale: Members cover 2-AG (DAG/MAG) and anandamide (NAPE/NAE) turnover and retrograde lipid signalling, whereas confusables are eicosanoid, resolvin and leukotriene/prostanoid pathways.

name: Inflammatory chemokine output and leukocyte adhesion to endothelium
rationale: Members are myeloid proinflammatory chemokine/cytokine programmes and control of IL-8, CXCL2, MCP-1 and adhesion-molecule production, leukocyte-endothelial adhesion and extravasation, unlike confusables focused on monocyte chemotaxis or NF-kB activation.

core: Viral genome replication and gene expression in host
name: Viral genome replication, transcription and translation, including retroviral integration
rationale: Members are intracellular steps of the viral life cycle (genome synthesis, transcription, translation and host interference) across HIV, HCMV, influenza, RSV and coronaviruses; the HIV reverse transcription/integration and viral transcription regulation members distinguish it from confusables.

name: APC/C-Cdc20 degradation of securin and cyclin B
rationale: Members are Cdc20-bound APC/C destruction of securin and cyclin B at anaphase onset and its direct inhibition, unlike confusables on APC/C-Cdh1, Emi1, cyclin A/Nek2A or mitotic kinases.

name: Fas ligand-induced apoptosis and its negative regulation
rationale: Members concern FasL/CD95 death-receptor signalling, BID activation, activation-induced T cell death and restraint of death-receptor and hepatocyte apoptosis, unlike TRAIL/caspase-8 confusables.

name: Dendritic cell antigen presentation driving CD4 T cell proliferation
rationale: Members link myeloid dendritic cell activation and TCR-MHC contact to positive regulation of CD4 alpha-beta T cell proliferation, whereas confusables are negative regulation of T cell responses, Treg differentiation or cell-surface signatures.

name: Carnitine shuttle, fatty acid oxidation and ketone body metabolism
rationale: Members cover carnitine transport/shuttle into mitochondria, promotion of beta-oxidation and ketone body synthesis and use, unlike confusables that are individual beta-oxidation steps or fatty acid transport.

name: DNA replication initiation and replication-stress checkpoint signaling
rationale: Members are initiation and control of S-phase DNA replication with ATR, intra-S and replication checkpoints, unlike confusables on E2F transcription, G2/M progression or pre-replicative complex assembly.

name: Neuropeptide release and opioid G protein signaling
rationale: Members are dense-core vesicle neuropeptide release and neuropeptide/opioid GPCR-G protein signalling, unlike confusables on drug-response behaviour, orexin sleep regulation or stress responses.

core: p53-mediated intrinsic apoptosis after DNA damage
name: p53 apoptotic gene transcription and its negative regulation
rationale: Members are p53 transcription of death genes (caspases, death receptors, PUMA, cytochrome c release) and negative regulation of p53/DNA-damage intrinsic apoptosis, unlike confusables limited to positive regulation, NOXA/BH3 events or p53 expression control.

name: Caspase-4 and caspase-5 noncanonical inflammasome
rationale: All members are CASP4/CASP5 inflammasome assembly and substrate cleavage, distinct from NLRP1/NLRP3/AIM2/IPAF inflammasomes and pyroptosis confusables.

core: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA stability and translation
name: 3'-UTR-binding protein control of mRNA decay and translation
rationale: Members are RNA-binding proteins (TTP, AUF1, HuR, KSRP, BRF1, IGF2BPs, L13a) and decay steps that stabilise, destabilise or silence cytoplasmic mRNAs, unlike confusables on deadenylation machinery, nuclear 3'-end processing or stress granules.

name: tRNA processing, modification and aminoacylation for translational fidelity
rationale: Members are nuclear tRNA processing, anticodon modifications, cytosolic/mitochondrial aminoacylation and selenocysteine charging that safeguard decoding, unlike confusables on translation-factor modification or mitochondrial RNA processing.

name: Promotion of leading-edge lamellipodium and pseudopodium formation
rationale: Members promote lamellipodium and pseudopodium formation and protein localisation to the leading edge, whereas confusables concern actin severing, Rho GTPase cycles or negative regulation of protrusion and adhesion.

name: Osteoblast proliferation, differentiation and intramembranous bone formation
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast proliferation, differentiation and development and direct ossification, trabecular and cranial suture bone formation, unlike confusables centred on RUNX2, cartilage or mesenchymal stem cell/Wnt signalling.

name: Protein lipoylation and lipoyl-dependent pyruvate and 2-oxoglutarate dehydrogenases
rationale: Members are protein lipoylation and the lipoylated DLD-containing PDH, OGDH, OADH and glycine cleavage complexes (lysine and glycine catabolism), unlike branched-chain ketoacid dehydrogenase, TCA cycle or CoA biosynthesis confusables.

name: Glycine, threonine and alanine metabolism, creatine synthesis and gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members cover glycine, threonine, alanine and glyoxylate metabolism feeding creatine synthesis and gluconeogenesis, distinguished from confusables by creatine/phosphocreatine and gluconeogenic oxaloacetate members.

core: Sympathoadrenal and enteric neural crest development
name: Sympathoadrenal and enteric neural crest development, catecholamine synthesis
rationale: Members are RET/GDNF and endothelin signalling in neural crest-derived sympathetic, adrenal and enteric lineages plus noradrenaline/adrenaline synthesis, whereas confusables concern gut motility and endothelin blood pressure control.

name: NOD1/NOD2 peptidoglycan sensing in antibacterial innate immunity
rationale: Members are bacterial detection via NOD1/NOD2 and NLR responses to peptidoglycan and muramyl dipeptide, unlike confusables on downstream NF-kB/TLR signalling, LPS sensing or caspase inflammasomes.

name: Trans-Golgi network vesicle biogenesis and lysosomal protein sorting
rationale: Members are TGN-derived vesicle formation, retrograde TGN transport, protein secretion and targeting to lysosomes, unlike confusables on intra-Golgi traffic, endosome-to-Golgi retrieval or lysosome-related organelles.

name: CD4 T cell fate choice favoring Treg and Th1 differentiation
rationale: Members regulate differentiation of naive CD4 T cells toward Treg and Th1 fates while restraining Th17 commitment, unlike confusables on negative regulation of T cell activation or Th1 effector cytokines.
